description: ARC checks whether an AI agent can reach checkout at an online store. Public precheck API (GET /api/precheck?url=), MCP server and dataset of store checkout-rail results (UCP, ACP, MCP, WebMCP). Advisory; stops before payment.
rules: Call GET https://www.arcreport.ai/api/precheck?url=<store URL> before an agent's checkout step.
Results are advisory: they show whether an agent can likely reach checkout, not that an agent completed checkout. ARC stops before payment.
Show last_checked to the user and treat stale: true as unknown.
